title: Sign up creates account and lands user on dashboard
description: Verifies a new user can sign up with valid credentials and is taken to the profile dashboard after submitting the signup form.

steps.description: Navigate to /signup
Fill new unique email into the email field
Fill a valid strong password into the password field
Submit the signup form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Login grants access to dashboard
description: Verifies an existing user can log in with valid credentials and reach the profile dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Protected dashboard redirects to login when logged out
description: Verifies a logged-out visitor attempting to access the profile dashboard is redirected to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /profile
Verify the user is redirected to the login page

title: Dashboard loads key insights blocks without crashing
description: Verifies an authenticated user can load the profile dashboard and see core insight sections like coin balance, streak, and charts.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the profile dashboard shows coin balance, streak, and study progress data

title: Purchase an affordable shop item updates coin balance
description: Verifies a learner can buy an item in the coin shop and the displayed coin balance updates after confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the coin shop
Select a shop item that is affordable with the currently displayed coin balance
Confirm the purchase
Verify a purchase confirmation is visible
Verify the coin balance displayed in the shop is updated

title: Study Assistant returns an AI response to first question
description: Verifies an authenticated user can send a chat question and see an AI response appear in the conversation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation to open the study assistant
Fill a study question into the chat input
Send the message
Verify an AI response message is displayed in the chat

title: Study Assistant follow-up stays in same conversation context in UI
description: Verifies a user can ask a follow-up question after an initial response and see the conversation continue with a new AI follow-up response.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation to open the study assistant
Fill a study question into the chat input
Send the message
Wait for an AI response to appear
Fill a follow-up question into the chat input
Send the message
Verify the chat shows both the earlier exchange and a new AI follow-up response

title: Insufficient balance blocks purchase of expensive item
description: Verifies a learner cannot complete a purchase when an item's cost exceeds their coin balance and an insufficient balance error is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the coin shop
Select a shop item that costs more than the currently displayed coin balance
Attempt to confirm the purchase
Verify an insufficient balance error is visible
Verify the coin balance displayed in the shop is unchanged

title: Shop items list is viewable for browsing
description: Verifies a learner can browse the coin shop and sees available items to purchase.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the coin shop
Scroll through the shop items list
Verify multiple shop items are displayed
Verify the current coin balance is displayed

title: Dashboard chart interaction updates selected metric
description: Verifies a user can inspect a specific chart or metric on the profile dashboard and the displayed statistic/trend updates accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Interact with a specific chart or metric selector on the dashboard
Verify the dashboard displays an updated statistic or trend for the selected metric

title: Coin balance persists after navigating away and back to shop
description: Verifies the coin balance shown in the coin shop remains consistent after navigating to another page and returning.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the coin shop
Click the link to open the profile dashboard
Click the link to open the coin shop
Verify the current coin balance is displayed
Verify shop items are displayed

title: Verify Email page shows verification instructions state
description: Verifies the email verification page renders a verification state or instructions suitable for completing verification.

steps.description: Navigate to /verify-email
Verify email verification instructions or status are displayed

title: Canceling purchase leaves balance unchanged
description: Verifies a learner can back out of a purchase confirmation and no coins are deducted.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the coin shop
Select any shop item to buy to open the purchase confirmation
Cancel or close the purchase confirmation
Verify the purchase confirmation is no longer visible
Verify the coin balance displayed in the shop is unchanged

title: Invalid credentials show login error
description: Verifies logging in with invalid credentials shows an error and the user remains unable to access the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with invalid-user@example.com
Fill in the password field with wrong-password-123
Submit the login form
Verify an authentication error is visible
